messages:
Alex: Heads-up — eu-west-1 GPUs are at sustained saturation since ~07:40, queue depth doubled and p95 token latency is trending up. Thinking we should revisit admission policy (reject vs degrade vs queue).
Maria: Got the alert. Can you paste the current numbers? Q depth, reject rate, queued TTL? :thinking:
Alex: Q depth ~120 -> normal is <40. Reject rate currently 0 (we auto-queue right now). avg processing time increased 2.3x. TTL for queued jobs is 60s.
Sam: If we keep pure queueing customers suffer long tail latency. I prefer degrade-first: fallback to 8-bit quant model or limit max tokens for non-SLA traffic. Cheaper and keeps some throughput.
Jordan: Degrade helps quality though — we need guardrails. Suggest policy: 1) Reject cached/low priority requests early, 2) Degrade to quantized model for best-effort class, 3) Short queue (ttl 15s) for premium.
Lee: How about a hybrid rate-limiter + backpressure signal to upstream? If we start returning 429 for low-prio, they can retry with backoff. Also we can emit X-Queue-Time header so clients can adapt.
Maria: Agree on headers. We also need to track "degrade_count", "reject_count" and "queue_drop_count" in telemetry. Dashboards updated?
Alex: Not yet. Can someone add metrics and an emergency runbook for manual overrides?
Sam: I'll add a small change to router to map priority -> admission action. Pseudoconfig: 
```yaml
admission_policies:
  - priority: premium
    action: queue
    ttl_seconds: 15
  - priority: standard
    action: degrade
    degrade_to: quant8
  - priority: free
    action: reject
```
Jordan: Quick note: degrading to quant8 saves ~45% GPU cycles in our perf tests but increases occasional hallucination rate on long prompts. We should gate degrade by prompt-length threshold.
Lee: Region constraints: we can route eu-west overflow to us-central if network adds <40ms. Anyone measured cross-region tail?
Alex: Measured tail adding ~38ms median, p95 around 85ms during peak. OK for many customers but not for low-latency SLAs.
Maria: Ops-bot just posted the incident: 
ops-bot: [ALERT] eu-west-1 gpu_saturation threshold breached (92%) — auto-scaling at capacity.
Sam: Plan proposal: deploy hybrid admission policy to beta where: free -> 429 (reject), standard -> degrade with quant8 & token cap 512, premium -> short queue 15s + header + fallback to us-central. Run for 3h during peak and measure latency, cost, degrade_count.
Jordan: Can we add a canary flag per-customer to opt-out of degrade? Some enterprise customers will want to be pinned.
Lee: Yes — default pinned customers go to premium route. We'll need a rollout plan in console for quick toggles.
Maria: I'll instrument metrics (degrade_count, reject_count, avg_queue_time, cross_region_fallbacks) and add graphs. Also set alert if reject_rate > 5% for premium.
Alex: Thx. Who will own the deploy? Sam + Lee pair for router changes, Maria for telemetry, Jordan for validation tests.
Sam: I'll open a PR with config and small router change. Keep it small; no model server changes.
Jordan: I'll create a test set to evaluate quality delta for quant8 on standard workloads.
Alex: Good. Schedule: PR today, beta deploy tom morning 06:00 UTC, monitor 8h window. If regressions, rollback to pure-queue.
Maria: Added a dashboard and an alert. Team, ping here if you see >10% degradation in user-facing latency. :fire:
Lee: Also adding a toggle in console for immediate manual override.
Alex: Solid. Thanks all — let's sync in 2h for status.
ops-bot: [INFO] Incident assigned to eng-infra. Priority: P2.
